subject: Reseller withholding reclaim + deferred payment retry plan
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@northstar-resellers.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@northstar-resellers.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Payout hold + VAT withholding on Aug payout

Hi Sofia,

We noticed that the Aug payouts to our seller account were net of a 20% VAT withholding that we weren't aware would be retained by AWS Marketplace for EU-resellers. This resulted in a ~€18k shortfall for our August remittance. Attached is our payout statement and the invoice (invoice-5421.pdf) that was expected to be paid in full. Can you confirm whether Redwood initiated any special tax routing or if this is a marketplace-side withholding?

We already opened a case with AWS Marketplace finance (they gave us Dispute ID 98765) but they are requesting seller-side evidence from Redwood to support a reclaim — confirmation of tax tags, original gross payout, and any merchant_id mapping used by your listing.

Appreciate a quick turnaround—this is material for our cash flow this month.

Attachments: payout-statement-Aug-2026.csv (CSV), invoice-5421.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Finance, NorthStar Resellers
billing@northstar-resellers.com
+44 20 5555 0123
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@northstar-resellers.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payout hold + VAT withholding on Aug payout

Hi Maya—thanks for flagging and for the attachments.

We're looking into this now. Preliminary notes: Redwood does not instruct AWS to apply withholding on merchant-share payouts — those come from marketplace platform settings. That said, we do send tax-tag metadata with each metered usage report and we include merchant_id mapping in the listing payload. To move quickly, can you confirm the exact marketplace listing SKU and the seller account ID that appears on invoice-5421 (so we can match to our send logs)? AWS has asked for: 1) confirmation of the original gross payout amount, 2) our transmitted tax tag (if any) for those SKUs, and 3) evidence that the payment route was the marketplace and not a direct Redwood transfer.

I'll loop in Monica from Finance to pull the payout export and Karthik from Platform/Tax to pull the listing metadata. If helpful we can produce a one-page evidence pack for AWS to support the reclaim.

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Monica: export the ledger rows + gross payout calculations for the affected seller (Monica, see the requested CSV above).
- Karthik: confirm the tax_tag and merchant_id we sent for the listing in question and whether any override was present in Aug.
- I'll coordinate a single package to upload to AWS Dispute ID 98765 and share a short memo with NorthStar.

I'll aim to have a first-pass packet by EOD today.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 13:10:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Payout hold + VAT withholding on Aug payout — action items

Monica / Karthik / Marissa — forwarding NorthStar's thread (below). Key asks from AWS: gross payout confirmation, tax_tag evidence, merchant_id mapping, and a short explanation of our routing (Redwood -> AWS marketplace listing vs direct).

Monica: please pull the full payout export for the NorthStar merchant_id for Aug (CSV attached in original) and include per-invoice gross amounts before marketplace fees. Also include any adjustment reasons / refunds that could have triggered a hold.

Karthik: can you pull the listing metadata for SKU NSR-RED-001 (NorthStar told us that appears on invoice-5421) for the date range July 28 — Aug 31, 2026. Specifically we need the tax_tag field and merchant_id that was transmitted to AWS. If any manual override or special routing existed in Aug, flag it.

Marissa: please scope whether we should open a support escalation with AWS Marketplace on behalf of Redwood to throttle the hold and request a provisional release of funds pending reclaim. If AWS won't provide interim relief, we should provide NorthStar a deferred payment schedule and cover a short-term credit to avoid disrupting their operations — need your estimate of exposure and credit runway.

Target timelines: first evidence pack by EOD today (2 Sep). If we can't get AWS to provisionally release, propose we commit to a 30-day deferred payout schedule with weekly partial remits and a one-time credit capped at €5k while reclaim proceeds. Confirm feasibility and sign-off.

Thanks — cc'ing NorthStar for transparency.

--
Sofia
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@northstar-resellers.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payout hold + VAT withholding on Aug payout — evidence pack + proposed payment retry

Hi Maya / team,

Thanks for your patience. Attached is the payout export we generated (payout-statement-Aug-2026.csv) showing the gross payout line that corresponds to invoice-5421 and the marketplace fees. Gross payout before marketplace withholding: €91,237. The net remitted to you was €72,989 (difference €18,248, which matches NorthStar's shortfall).

Karthik confirmed the listing info and tax tags we sent for SKU NSR-RED-001: merchant_id=NSR-ACC-778, tax_tag=EU_VAT_20. No manual override was present in Aug. We transmit tax_tag per SKU and leave final tax treatment to the marketplace's payment engine.

Next steps we completed for AWS Dispute ID 98765:
- Uploaded the payout export and invoice PDF (marketplace-dispute-98765.pdf) with a short memo explaining our data.
- Filed a request for provisional release — AWS responded that provisional releases are exceptional and they'll review within 5–7 business days.

Contingency for NorthStar (if AWS denies provisional release):
- Redwood can offer a 30-day deferred payout plan: weekly partial remits (max 3 remits over 30 days) covering 50% of the withheld amount upfront and remaining 50% once reclaim succeeds.
- One-time safety credit: up to €5,000 to cover urgent cashflow gaps (requires CFO approval).

Please confirm which option you prefer; if you accept the deferred remits we'll prepare a short mutual action plan and a DocuSign for acceptance.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Revenue Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: payout-statement-Aug-2026.csv (CSV), marketplace-dispute-98765.pdf (PDF)
